cc:Work.dc:title: Matched observation semantics: paired effects
cc:Work.dc:description: 60 paired independent starts; newly trained BC policies only; never pooled with historical frozen BC. Dots: paired means; lines: pointwise 95% paired-start bootstrap intervals (20,000 draws). Joint effects equally weight both noises. Positive success differences favor canonical; negative capped-control differences mean fewer controls. No multiplicity correction.
